entries.en: Hope I remember my low-gravity combat training.
Damn geth have us at a disadvantage, Commander. Synthetic bastards don't even need space suits out here.
A spacewalk up the side of the Citadel? You certainly like to keep things interesting, Commander.
Never thought I'd see the Citadel from this angle, Shepard.
Gravity's not too strong here, Shepard. If you ever get a chance to blast your target off into space, do it. Just watch 'em float away.
Don't worry about me, Shepard. Quarians are used to making spacewalks. It comes in handy if we have to make repairs on our ships.
Husks. The ship's probably crawling with them.
Husks. The ship is probably crawling with them.
Husks. Ship's probably crawling with them.
No need to worry about survivors, then.
Guess we don't have to worry about looking for survivors.
Not much chance we'll find any survivors.
Finding survivors seems unlikely.
I don't think we're going to find any survivors.
According to the log files, the ship was out near the Perseus Veil. Looks like they found some kind of alien artifact.
The entries don't make a lot of sense after that. It's like the captain's mind was falling apart. I don't see anything about how they got back into human territory.
The entries don't make a lot of sense after that. It's like the captain's mind was falling apart. It doesn't say anything about how they got back into our territory.

After that, the entries become confused. As if the captain's mind was degenerating. There is no mention of how the ship returned to human territory.
The geth turned them into husks and left the ship where someone would find it. Trying to show us what happens to organics dumb enough to enter the Veil.
The geth transformed them into husks and left the vessel where they knew it would be found. A warning to other organics not to enter the Veil.
The geth turned them into husks and left the ship where someone would find it. Trying to show us what happens to anyone who goes into the Veil.
The logs show this ship was exploring near the Perseus Veil. Looks like they found some kind of alien artifact.
According to the log files, the ship was out near the Perseus Veil. It seems they found an alien artifact of some kind.
Logs say the ship was out near the Perseus Veil. Looks like they found some alien artifact.
They brought it on board and then... this is really weird, Shepard. They plotted a course straight into the Perseus Veil. Like they wanted the geth to find them.

That artifact let Sovereign subvert their free will. Like he did with Saren. Why else would they fly into geth space?
That artifact must have done something to them. Why else would someone fly into geth space?
Is that all?
They were indoctrinated.
They were brainwashed.
I'm right here.
Ready whenever you are.
Yes, sir.
Yes, ma'am.
On your order.
Ready to move.
Waiting for orders.
Ready.

Charged and locked.
I'm on it.

Lead on, Commander.
Just lead the way.
I'm here if you need me.
Right behind you, Shepard.
Let's get moving.
No sense standing around.
Let's go.
You lead, I'll follow.
Thank you, Commander. I thought I was dead when they took me.
I'll see to it that the reparations discussion is reopened. I didn't know they were so desperate.
You're too late! The chairman is dead... and so are you!
